subject.title: [Feature]: Supports Windows 11 MSYS environment and Fishshell.

question: Should OpenClaw officially support MSYS2/MINGW `install.sh` installs and fish PATH persistence on Windows, or keep Windows terminal installs limited to PowerShell and WSL2?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting MSYS2/MINGW changes a documented Windows support boundary and needs maintainer-owned platform coverage expectations.

options.title: Approve MSYS2/fish support
options.body: Implement explicit MSYS2/MINGW detection, safe install decisions, fish-aware PATH handling or guidance, docs, and a real Windows 11 smoke path.

options.title: Keep current Windows boundary
options.body: Document MSYS2/MINGW as unsupported for `install.sh` and route users to Windows Hub, PowerShell `install.ps1`, or WSL2.

options.title: Fold into broader Windows planning
options.body: Keep this linked to the Microsoft/Windows tracker until maintainers settle the Windows shell support matrix.

recommendation.title: Approve MSYS2/fish support
recommendation.body: Implement explicit MSYS2/MINGW detection, safe install decisions, fish-aware PATH handling or guidance, docs, and a real Windows 11 smoke path.
